name: What should I consider when choosing a night light for my bedroom?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a night light for my bedroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a night light, consider its intended purpose: is it for safety, ambiance, or both? Evaluate the light's brightness and color temperature; warm, dim lights are generally better for sleep. Look for features like motion sensors, dimmers, or timers for added convenience and energy savings. Also, consider the installation type (plug-in, hardwired, battery-operated) and how it integrates with your bedroom's decor and existing electrical setup. Safety certifications are also important for any electrical device.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider purpose, brightness, color temperature, features like motion sensors, installation type, and how it matches your decor.
